name: ThemeFontScheme
description: Represents the font scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.
example:
Dim tTheme As OfficeTheme
Dim tfsThemeFontScheme As ThemeFontScheme
Set tfsThemeFontScheme = tTheme.ThemeFontScheme

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ThemeFontScheme object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ThemeFontScheme object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ThemeFontScheme object. Read-only.

properties.name: MinorFont
properties.description: Gets the font settings for the Body of a document. Read-only.

properties.name: MajorFont
properties.description: Gets the font setting for the Headings in a document. Read-only.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the font scheme of a Microsoft Office theme from a file.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the font scheme file.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the font scheme of a Microsoft Office theme to a file.
